name: bdxy-correlation-us-rates
description: BMO reproduction: 3m rolling correlation of USD (UUP as DXY proxy) to US 2Y, 10Y, 2s10s, SPX. BP changes for yields (avoids zero-crossing inf), % returns for prices.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BMO REPRODUCTION: USD CORRELATION TO US MARKET VARIABLES
# =============================================================================
# 3-month (63d) rolling Pearson correlation of USD returns to:
#   - US 2Y yield bp changes
#   - US 10Y yield bp changes
#   - US 2s10s spread bp changes
#   - SPX % returns
#
# USD proxy: UUP (Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund, tracks DXY)
# Yields: bp changes (value - lag) to avoid inf when 2s10s crosses zero
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary Asset: SPY (US equity benchmark) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close_spy = src.c
ret_spy = returns(period=1)(close_spy)

# --- USD Proxy: UUP (DXY tracker) ---
uup_src = reference_stocks(ticker='UUP')()
close_uup = uup_src.c
ret_uup = returns(period=1)(close_uup)

# --- US Treasury Yields (FRED) ---
t2y_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury2Y)()
t2y = ffill(t2y_src.result)

t10y_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
t10y = ffill(t10y_src.result)

spread_2s10s = t10y - t2y

# --- Daily Changes: BP for yields, % for prices ---
chg_t2y = t2y - (t2y >> 1)
chg_t10y = t10y - (t10y >> 1)
chg_2s10s = spread_2s10s - (spread_2s10s >> 1)

# =============================================================================
# 3-MONTH ROLLING CORRELATIONS (63 trading days)
# =============================================================================

corr_usd_t2y = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_uup, y=chg_t2y)
corr_usd_t10y = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_uup, y=chg_t10y)
corr_usd_2s10s = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_uup, y=chg_2s10s)
corr_usd_spy = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_uup, y=ret_spy)

idx = index()()

# =============================================================================
# CHART
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='USD Reconnecting With Rates, Less Driven by Yield Curve (3m Rolling Corr)',
    category='USD Correlation Structure',
    y_axis_label='Rolling 63d Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 2Y Yield', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 10Y Yield', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 2s10s Spread', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPX', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, corr_usd_t2y, corr_usd_t10y, corr_usd_2s10s, corr_usd_spy)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='USD Correlation to US Market Variables (Latest 63d)',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['63d Corr'],
        col_headers=['US 2Y', 'US 10Y', '2s10s', 'SPX'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Red)
        ]
    ),
    category='USD Correlation Structure',
    order=1
)(corr_usd_t2y, corr_usd_t10y, corr_usd_2s10s, corr_usd_spy)
